# sendio_template (Resource)

An email template. Every change is saved as a new draft version; with `publish = true` the draft is published so sends use it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendio_template" "welcome" {
  name    = "Welcome"
  alias   = "welcome"
  subject = "Welcome, {{{FIRST_NAME}}}"
  from    = "Acme <hello@mail.example.com>"
  html    = "<p>Hi {{{FIRST_NAME}}}, your trial has {{{DAYS}}} days left.</p>"
  text    = "Hi {{{FIRST_NAME}}}, your trial has {{{DAYS}}} days left."
  publish = true

  variables = [
    { key = "FIRST_NAME", type = "string", fallback_value = "there" },
    { key = "DAYS", type = "number", fallback_value = "14" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `html` (String) HTML body.
- `name` (String) Template name.

### Optional

- `alias` (String) Unique alias usable in place of the id when sending.
- `from` (String) Default sender, for example `Acme <hello@mail.example.com>` (required to publish; its domain must be verified).
- `preview_text` (String) Inbox preview text.
- `publish` (Boolean) Publish the draft after every change. When the template gets unpublished edits outside Terraform, the next plan shows it being published again. Setting it back to `false` does not unpublish.
- `subject` (String) Subject line (required to publish).
- `template_engine` (String) `simple` (default, `{{{VAR}}}` placeholders) or `handlebars`.
- `text` (String) Plain-text body.
- `variables` (Attributes List) Variables the template uses (at most 50). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variables))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the template was created.
- `current_version_id` (String) Id of the version GET returns (the draft, else the published one).
- `has_unpublished_versions` (Boolean) Whether a draft newer than the published version exists.
- `id` (String) Template id.
- `published_at` (String) When the current published version was published.
- `status` (String) `draft` or `published`.
- `version_number` (Number) Number of that version.

<a id="nestedatt--variables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variables`

Required:

- `key` (String) Variable name.
- `type` (String) `string` or `number`; with the handlebars engine also `boolean`, `object` or `array`.

Optional:

- `fallback_value` (String) Value used when a send leaves the variable out: text for `string`, a number for `number`, `true`/`false` for `boolean`, JSON for `object` and `array`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By id or by alias
terraform import sendio_template.welcome welcome
```
